question: Which of the following is a famous festival among the people belonging to the Angami tribe in Nagaland?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sekrenyi**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Angami tribe** of Nagaland celebrates the **Sekrenyi festival**, which is a significant cultural and religious event.
 
• It is also known as the **"Festival of Purification"** and is observed in February.
